title: **The Great Imposter: The Case of Frank Abagnale Jr.**

scenes.text: Frank Abagnale Jr. was a con man who impersonated a pilot, a doctor, and a lawyer, among others, and was the inspiration for the movie Catch Me If You Can.
Abagnale's exploits were widely publicized in the 1960s and 1970s.

scenes.label: Master Impostor
scenes.text: Abagnale's story is a fascinating example of deception and trickery.
Follow if you'd have cracked this one.

description: Frank Abagnale Jr. was a master imposter who deceived hundreds of people. His story is a fascinating example of deception and trickery. Follow us for more fascinating true crime stories.
